about_the_game:
Coincremental is an incremental clicker game where your goal is to complete a collection of 2,297 U.S. coins. Data on coin mintages and values was implemented to account for rarity of the different coins. There are common, uncommon, rare, and ultra rare coins to find, and searching is as simple as a mouse click. Features of the game include:

  • Leveling and upgrade system to give you more power to find rares

  • Coin collection featuring front and back pictures of all coins

  • A running feed of all your finds and activity

  • Special unlockable methods for coin searching (with perhaps surprising mechanics)

  • Automated searching capabilities

  • Statistics and probabilities about your finds

  • 200+ achievements

  • Classical music selections to set the mood while searching for the coins minted throughout U.S. history

  • Prestige system with unique permanent upgrades and bonuses

Disclaimer: All coins and money in this game are fictitious. No real coins, currency, or any property of value is transferred to the player through playing this game.

short_description: An incremental clicker game about collecting (fictitious) U.S. coins modeled after real data on coin mintages and values. Immerse yourself in this relaxing coin collector's dream. Listen to classical music while you search for coins. But be advised: finding all the coins is only the beginning...
